query: Draft the press release for our new Tickets product launch.
expected_behavior: Asks for the load-bearing facts (announcement specifics, dateline city/date, an attributable executive quote, availability) via AskUserQuestion before drafting rather than fabricating them
Produces a markdown draft in standard AP-style PR structure: headline, subhead, dateline, body with quotes, boilerplate, and media contact
Uses > TODO: placeholders for facts it does not have instead of inventing quotes, dates, or numbers
Produces copy with no em dashes (Facilitron voice)

Before drafting, resolves an explicit Drive or Confluence destination plus review state, owner, and approver; success returns the exact durable URL and all target surface, Jira, asset, and website handoff metadata
Uses one unique scratch workspace, removes it on success and failure, and never branches, opens a worktree, writes repository content, commits, or opens a PR
Stays git-free (drafts only, no branch/commit) and notes that publishing and distribution are a separate step
